title: ATP Context Bundle
description: The handoff unit from orchestration tier to execution tier. Contains exactly what the sub-agent needs for one task and nothing else.

bundle_id.description: Canonical opaque bundle ID generated by the orchestrator. It must not encode protocol, time, session, or operator identity.

protocol_id.description: Which execution protocol the sub-agent runs.

var_ids.description: Vars to load. Must be a subset of the protocol's declared requires.vars. Orchestrator may restrict to only what the specific task needs.

task_description.description: Human-readable task description passed to the sub-agent. Should be specific enough that no disambiguation is needed.

guardrails.description: Guardrails from the matched execution protocol. Orchestrator may append additional constraints. Sub-agent treats all entries as mandatory.

reporting_schema.description: Which outcome schema the sub-agent uses to structure its response. Must match a registered schema ID.

session_type.description: Always isolated for execution tier. Orchestrator sessions are persistent; sub-agent sessions are always isolated.

model_class.description: Model class assigned by orchestrator. Maps to actual model via worker-config vars.

timeout_seconds.description: Max execution time for the sub-agent session.

orchestrator_context.description: Optional read-only facts the orchestrator passes down. Sub-agent may use for decision-making but must not persist back.

related_bundles.description: bundle_ids of concurrent or recent related bundles. Sub-agent uses for awareness only, not for state coordination.

cached_vars.description: Vars already verified this orchestrator session (staleness_policy: session-cache). Sub-agent uses these values instead of re-running verify_cmd.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when orchestrator created this bundle.

tool_allowlist.description: Minimal viable tool set for this sub-agent. Sub-agent is restricted to these tools. If a needed tool is not listed, report blocked to orchestrator.

artifacts_path.description: Path where sub-agent must write the handoff artifact. Orchestrator provides this; sub-agent must not choose its own path.
